title: Forward returns — the record's first analytical answer

components.purpose: Say what price did by the next capture when each state held — with the depth the figures stand on stated before any of them.
components.current_implementation: Four arms. `analysis`: a role=status notice-tinted depth line (pair count, series count, window, exclusions with the cadence-step sentence, and the small-samples honesty line), then a Baseline section in prose (n, mean, median, share positive, 'read against this, not against zero'), then three plain tables (By triggered signal / By dominant bias / By conflicting signals) each in an overflow-x-auto wrapper with columns key, Pairs, Mean, Median, Positive — rows arrive in the query's order (sample size descending, key ascending) and are rendered as given. `not-deep-enough`: one paragraph stating capture count, series count and window, naming itself a fact about depth rather than a failure. `never-recorded`: the how-recording-starts sentence, shared with the coverage surface. `unreadable`: role=alert danger-tinted block with the reason and the does-not-mean-empty survival sentence in the record's own terms. Signed percents render with a real minus sign at three decimals; shares as whole percents; timestamps as UTC minutes.
constraints: The depth line renders BEFORE any figure — the reader learns what the numbers stand on before reading them (spec: Forward Returns Are Derived From The Record, With Their Sample Sizes)
Every figure carries the pair count it is computed from; a design may restyle the tables but may not detach a figure from its n
Row order is the query's — sample size descending — and a design MUST NOT reorder by the return column: sorting by the interesting column is how a two-sample fluke tops the table (spec-pinned)

The four arms stay distinct: not-deep-enough is a fact about depth, never-recorded is about the recorder, unreadable is about the read — each sends the operator somewhere different and none may borrow another's words

The unreadable arm deliberately does NOT use the shared WhyNotLoaded sentence: this surface reads the product's own store and never BattleGrid, so the shared cause vocabulary would be false here (exempted with the stated reason in failure-is-explained.test.ts). A design must not wire it back in
Percent signs use the real minus (U+2212); a hyphen-minus regression is a legibility change, not a neutral one

components.purpose: Turn away a request with no authority.
components.current_implementation: Shared component rendered in place of the page body. Reachable only on a delegated deployment.
constraints: One page for every cause; they differ in cause and not in remedy (design W-C)

flows.name: Read the analysis against its depth
steps: read the depth line first — pairs, window, exclusions
read the tables against the baseline, best-attested rows first

accessibility.notes: The depth line carries role=status; the unreadable arm carries role=alert. Tables are native <table> elements with header cells; wide tables scroll inside their own container rather than the page.
